interpretation: jsQR decoded both original app screenshots exactly. OpenCV returned no text for the standard screenshot and its 400px crop, but decoded the identical QR pixels when surrounded by 40px additional white padding. This demonstrates sensitivity in the observed OpenCV pipeline; it does not establish a universal root cause or physical scanner success.
provenance: Decoder observations were recorded from the one diagnostic command following the failed strict run; padding pixel identity was verified without changing or repeating those decoder outcomes.
